create_session.details: Creates short-lived payment session with merchant details, product context, total amount, currency, and callback URL. Validates session_id, session_token, iframe_url, order_id, and expires_at response fields.

get_payment_result.details: Polls session payment status and line item credentials. Maps status (pending, awaiting_result, completed, failed) and line items.

report_status.details: Reports merchant checkout execution outcome (APPROVED/DECLINED) to Prava and retrieves Visa confirmation payload.

lock_virtual_card.details: Throws explicit contract guard error rejecting unsupported direct virtual-card locking without active session/mandate lifecycle. Validates cardId presence.

create_virtual_card.details: Throws explicit contract guard error rejecting direct card issuance outside approved Session path.
